name: functions-with-defaultable-parameters-test-517e580aad/default-parameters-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Mapping constructor — Currently [spread-field](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#spread-field) not supported
## Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
reason: The whole case requires an explicitly unsupported mapping spread field in a default parameter expression. testFuncWithSpreadFieldInMappingConstructorForDefaultValue constructs the default with {...r}, invokes y() with that argument omitted, and asserts 30. Support for defaultable parameters does not cover this required expression.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping constructor spread-field {...r} in the function-type default value
test_design_notes: main calls the spread-field test, so its asserted behavior is essential to the case. One explicit unsupported construct suffices for whole-case classification.
